finding.text: The index of `ext/Chat/` does not record `v2/` in the commit (Law 10, index everything). The worktree has `ext/Chat/files.jsonl` with `{"file":"v2/"}` and `{"file":"v2/page.js"}` modified but not committed (`git status` on worktree/chat-v2), so a merge of 5e3ff2a46 lands the folder unindexed. Commit that file, and the fixture's files.jsonl with it.

`fixture/files.jsonl` holds 10 `live-copy.jsonl` add/gone lines left over from test runs. Each run of `ChatV2.test.mjs` adds two more, because it writes its temp copy inside the served folder. The noise is harmless; to avoid it, write the copy to a folder the index skips, or squash the lines.

The brief asked for "a child Question answered and one open", but the fixture's second child question (`q-1761382836000`) is answered by a later line. Under the first prompt both questions draw ANSWERED (shots/…/1920.png, nest band), and the only open question is the root one under the second prompt. That covers the open phase, but not as a child in `tasks`.

At 400 the child-card head wraps: the QUESTION label, then 2–3 lines of text in a narrow column, then ANSWERED on its own line (shots/…/400.png, lower band). The text column is about 160px wide beside the label and icon. Putting the kind label and phase on their own line above the text at phone width would read better.
Not every field read goes through the Model. `ChatV2.child` reads `n.title ?? n.text ?? n.id` directly, so a field rename would mean two edits, against the brief's "one small method per field".

Chat v2 is not in `ext/Chat/page.js` `children: "panel drill"`, so it is reachable by URL and by the readme link only, not from the page tree. The fence allowed only the readme line, so the parent should add `v2` when it merges.
